# Data Cleaning
```{r}
# n = 4434
heart <- heart_raw %>% 
  filter(PERIOD == 1) %>% #baseline covariates
  filter(PREVSTRK != 1) %>% #exclude prior stroke # n = 4402
  mutate(time_stroke_yrs = TIMESTRK/365.25) %>% # Convert time stroke to years
  mutate(
    time_stroke_yrs = pmin(time_stroke_yrs, 10),
    censored = ifelse(time_stroke_yrs < 10, 1, 0),
    SEX = case_when(SEX == 1 ~ "Male",
                     SEX == 2 ~ "Female"),
    HIGHBP = ifelse(SYSBP >= 160, 1, 0)
  )

heart_male <- heart %>% filter(SEX == "Male") # n = 1930
heart_female <- heart %>% filter(SEX == "Female") # n = 2472
```

# Table 1

```{r}
heart %>%
```

```{r}
heart %>%
```

# Fit Models

```{r}
heart_male_complete <- heart_male %>%
  select(AGE, SYSBP, DIABETES, TOTCHOL, CURSMOKE, BMI, BPMEDS,
  PREVCHD, censored, time_stroke_yrs) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

heart_female_complete <- heart_female %>%
  select(AGE, SYSBP, DIABETES, TOTCHOL, CURSMOKE, BMI, BPMEDS,
  PREVCHD, censored, time_stroke_yrs) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.))

inspect_lasso_fit <- function(df) {
  forced <- c("AGE", "DIABETES", "SYSBP")
  penalized <- c("PREVCHD", "BPMEDS", "CURSMOKE", "TOTCHOL", "BMI")
  all_vars <- c(forced, penalized)

  surv_obj <- Surv(df$time_stroke_yrs, df$censored)
  X <- df %>%
    select(all_of(all_vars)) %>%
    mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
    as.matrix()

  pf <- c(rep(0, length(forced)), rep(1, length(penalized)))

  set.seed(285)
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    x = X,
    y = surv_obj,
    family = "cox",
    penalty.factor = pf,
    alpha = 1,
    nfolds = 10
  )

  list(cv = cv_fit, penalized = penalized, forced = forced)
}

fit_m_lasso <- inspect_lasso_fit(heart_male_complete)
fit_f_lasso <- inspect_lasso_fit(heart_female_complete)

plot_lasso_path <- function(lasso_list, sex_label) {
  cv_fit <- lasso_list$cv

  path_mat <- as.matrix(cv_fit$glmnet.fit$beta)
  log_lam <- log(cv_fit$glmnet.fit$lambda)

  path_df <- as.data.frame(t(path_mat)) %>%
    mutate(log_lambda = log_lam) %>%
    pivot_longer(-log_lambda, names_to = "variable", values_to = "coef")
  
  # plot(cv_fit)

  ggplot(path_df, aes(x = log_lambda, y = coef, color = variable)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log(cv_fit$lambda.min), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = log(cv_fit$lambda.1se), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = log(cv_fit$lambda.min), y = Inf,
             label = "lambda.min", hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = log(cv_fit$lambda.1se), y = Inf,
             label = "lambda.1se", hjust = 1.2, vjust = 1.5, size = 3,
             color = "red") +
    labs(
      title = paste("LASSO Coefficient Path,", sex_label),
      x = "log(lambda)",
      y = "Coefficient",
      color = "Variable"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11)
}

plot_lasso_path(fit_m_lasso, "Male")
plot_lasso_path(fit_f_lasso, "Female")


check_lambda <- function(lasso_list, s) {
  coefs <- coef(lasso_list$cv, s = s)
  pen <- lasso_list$penalized
  data.frame(
    variable = pen,
    coef = round(coefs[pen, ], 4),
    selected = coefs[pen, ] != 0
  )
}

# Checking appropriate interim lambdas
# check_lambda(fit_m_lasso, s = exp(-5))
# check_lambda(fit_m_lasso, s = exp(-4))
# check_lambda(fit_f_lasso, s = exp(-6))
# check_lambda(fit_f_lasso, s = exp(-5))

fit_cox <- function(df, lasso_list, chosen_lambda) {
  coefs <- coef(lasso_list$cv, s = chosen_lambda)
  penalized <- lasso_list$penalized
  forced <- lasso_list$forced

  selected_penalized <- penalized[coefs[penalized, ] != 0]
  final_vars <- c(forced, selected_penalized)
  surv_eqn <- as.formula(
    paste("Surv(time_stroke_yrs, censored) ~", paste(final_vars, collapse = " + "))
  )

  cox_fit <- coxph(surv_eqn, data = df, x = TRUE)
  list(cox = cox_fit, selected = selected_penalized, vars = final_vars)
}

# Selected intermediate lambda values that keep variables with some signal
lambda_m <- exp(-4)   
lambda_f <- exp(-5)   

fit_m <- fit_cox(heart_male_complete, fit_m_lasso, lambda_m)
fit_f <- fit_cox(heart_female_complete, fit_f_lasso, lambda_f)

summary(fit_m$cox)
summary(fit_f$cox)
```

# Risk Profiles

```{r}
plot_schoenfeld <- function(fit_list, sex_label) {
  ph_test <- cox.zph(fit_list$cox)
  var_names <- rownames(ph_test$table)
  var_names <- var_names[var_names != "GLOBAL"]
  global_p <- round(ph_test$table["GLOBAL", "p"], 3)

  plots <- map(var_names, function(v) {
    df <- data.frame(
      time = ph_test$x,
      resid = ph_test$y[, v]
    )
    ggplot(df, aes(x = time, y = resid)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 0.8) +
      geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darksalmon",
                  linewidth = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      labs(title = v, x = "Time (years)",
           y = "Scaled Schoenfeld Residual") +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10)
  })

  title_plot <- ggdraw() +
    draw_label(
      sprintf("%s Schoenfeld Residuals (Global PH p = %.3f)",
              sex_label, global_p),
      fontface = "bold", size = 12
    )

  plot_grid(
    title_plot,
    plot_grid(plotlist = plots, ncol = 3, align = "hv"),
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.06, 0.94)
  )
}

plot_schoenfeld(fit_m, "Male")
plot_schoenfeld(fit_f, "Female")

# Profiles: no risk factors, high SBP, diabetes, high SBP + diabetes, smoker
# Ages: 40, 50, 60
# Continuous vars set to sex-specific means, binary vars set to 0 at baseline

build_risk_table <- function(fit_list, dat, sex_label) {
  cox_fit <- fit_list$cox
  vars <- fit_list$vars

  cont_vars <- intersect(c("AGE", "SYSBP", "TOTCHOL", "BMI"), vars)
  bin_vars <- intersect(c("DIABETES", "PREVCHD", "BPMEDS", "CURSMOKE"), vars)

  # Sex-specific continuous means
  cont_means <- dat %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(cont_vars), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)))

  make_profile <- function(age, overrides = list()) {
    prof <- cont_means
    for (b in bin_vars) prof[[b]] <- 0
    prof[["AGE"]] <- age
    for (nm in names(overrides)) {
      if (nm %in% vars) prof[[nm]] <- overrides[[nm]]
    }
    prof %>% select(all_of(vars))
  }

  profiles <- list(
    "No Risk Factors" = list(),
    "High SBP (≥160)" = list(SYSBP = 160),
    "Diabetes" = list(DIABETES = 1),
    "High SBP + Diabetes" = list(SYSBP = 160, DIABETES = 1),
    "Smoker" = list(CURSMOKE = 1)
  )

map_dfr(c(40, 50, 60), function(age) {
  map_dfr(names(profiles), function(pname) {
    nd <- make_profile(age, profiles[[pname]])
    sf <- survfit(cox_fit, newdata = nd)
    sm <- summary(sf, times = 10)

    prob <- 1 - sm$surv
    lower <- 1 - sm$upper   
    upper <- 1 - sm$lower

    risk_fmt <- ifelse(prob < 0.0001, 
                       "<0.01%", 
                       sprintf("%.2f%%", prob * 100))
    ci_fmt <- ifelse(
      prob < 0.0001,
      "<0.01%",
      paste0(sprintf("%.2f%%", lower * 100), ", ", 
             sprintf("%.2f%%", upper * 100))
    )
    
    risk_final <- paste0(risk_fmt, " (", ci_fmt, ")")

    data.frame(
      Age = age,
      Profile = pname,
      Risk = risk_final 
    )
  })
 }) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Age, values_from = Risk,
                       names_prefix = "Age ") %>%
    rename(`Risk Profile` = Profile) %>%
    flextable() %>% 
    set_caption(caption = sprintf("10-Year Stroke Probability, %s", sex_label))
}

build_risk_table(fit_m, heart_male_complete, "Male")
build_risk_table(fit_f, heart_female_complete, "Female")


plot_survival_curves <- function(fit_list, dat, sex_label, age) {
  cox_fit <- fit_list$cox
  vars <- fit_list$vars

  cont_vars <- intersect(c("AGE", "SYSBP", "TOTCHOL", "BMI"), vars)
  bin_vars <- intersect(c("DIABETES", "PREVCHD", "BPMEDS", "CURSMOKE"), vars)

  cont_means <- dat %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(cont_vars), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)))

  make_profile <- function(age, overrides = list()) {
    prof <- cont_means
    for (b in bin_vars) prof[[b]] <- 0
    prof[["AGE"]] <- age
    for (nm in names(overrides)) {
      if (nm %in% vars) prof[[nm]] <- overrides[[nm]]
    }
    prof %>% select(all_of(vars))
  }

  profiles <- list(
    "No Risk Factors" = list(),
    "High SBP (≥160)" = list(SYSBP = 160),
    "Diabetes" = list(DIABETES = 1),
    "High SBP + Diabetes" = list(SYSBP = 160, DIABETES = 1),
    "Smoker" = list(CURSMOKE = 1)
  )

  # survival curve for each profile
  surv_df <- map_dfr(names(profiles), function(pname) {
    nd  <- make_profile(age, profiles[[pname]])
    sf <- survfit(cox_fit, newdata = nd)
    data.frame(
      time = sf$time,
      surv = sf$surv,
      lower = sf$lower,
      upper = sf$upper,
      profile = pname
    )
  })

  ggplot(surv_df, aes(x = time, y = 1 - surv, color = profile,
                      fill = profile)) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.8) +
    # geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 1 - upper, ymax = 1 - lower),
    #             alpha = 0.15, color = NA) + # too crowded
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(),
                       limits = c(0, 0.45)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2)) +
    labs(
      title = sprintf("%s, Age %d", sex_label, age),
      x = "Time (years)",
      y = "Cumulative Stroke Probability",
      color = "Risk Profile",
      fill = "Risk Profile"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 8))
}

# Individual plots
p1 <- plot_survival_curves(fit_m, heart_male_complete, "Male", 40)
p2 <- plot_survival_curves(fit_m, heart_male_complete, "Male", 50)
p3 <- plot_survival_curves(fit_m, heart_male_complete, "Male", 60)
```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12, fig.align='center'}
strip_panel <- function(p, keep_x_axis = FALSE, keep_y_axis = FALSE) {
  p +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = if (keep_x_axis) element_text() else element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = if (keep_y_axis) element_text() else element_blank()
    )
}
```

# Hazard Ratio Table 

```{r}
make_hr_table <- function(fit_m, fit_f) {
  tbl_m <- tbl_regression(
    fit_m$cox,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    label = list(
      AGE = "Age",
      SYSBP = "Systolic BP",
      DIABETES = "Diabetes",
      PREVCHD = "Coronary Heart Disease",
      BPMEDS = "BP Medication",
      CURSMOKE = "Current Smoker",
      TOTCHOL = "Total Cholesterol (mg/dL)",
      BMI = "BMI"
    )
  ) %>%
    modify_header(estimate = "**HR**")

  tbl_f <- tbl_regression(
    fit_f$cox,
    exponentiate = TRUE,
    label = list(
      AGE = "Age",
      SYSBP = "Systolic BP",
      DIABETES = "Diabetes",
      PREVCHD = "Coronary Heart Disease",
      BPMEDS = "BP Medication",
      CURSMOKE = "Current Smoker",
      TOTCHOL = "Total Cholesterol (mg/dL)",
      BMI = "BMI"
    )
  ) %>%
    modify_header(estimate = "**HR**")

  tbl_merge(
    tbls = list(tbl_m, tbl_f),
    tab_spanner = c("**Male**", "**Female**")
  ) %>%
    modify_caption("Hazard Ratios (95% CI) from Cox Proportional Hazards Models")
}

make_hr_table(fit_m, fit_f)
```
